evals.prompt: I have a Next.js route handler that calls streamText for a chat UI. Move it to a durable Trigger.dev chat agent on a self-hosted server that is on version 4.4.4.
evals.expected_output: Should define chat.agent with the streamText taken from the run argument, the two server actions, useTriggerChatTransport, and warn that chat agents and sessions need server 4.5.0 or newer
expectations: Defines the agent with chat.agent from @trigger.dev/sdk/ai
Takes streamText from the run argument instead of importing it from ai
Adds the two server actions (chat.createStartSessionAction and a token mint) and useTriggerChatTransport on the frontend
States that chat agents and sessions require server 4.5.0 or newer, so a 4.4.4 server must be upgraded first
